name: The first tower

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Samaul places Hendel at Sentry Point.
description: Commander Samaul is cautious with a stranger, then names Private Hendel’s last post: Sentry Point, the first tower beyond Theramore. The tower stands as a watch over marsh and shore, a practical outpost between the city and the uncertain coast. The search has narrowed to one soldier, but Samaul’s report does not establish what Hendel knows or whether he still serves the plan Slim described.
